response.rationale: HIGH flag POL-STOCK-01 (stock shortfall: 20 > 5 available) prevents approval per policy; total $15000 exceeds both POL-THRESHOLD-10K ($10000) and POL-VENDOR-02 vendor limit ($7500); POL-THRESHOLD-10K requires VP-level review with explicit rationale on every HIGH/CRITICAL flag and prohibits silent approval, so escalation to human is required.
